citation_chaining.strategy: forward and backward citation and software-repository chaining from the frozen related-work inventory

exclusion_criteria: not an RNA-DNA-DNA triplex prediction, screening, or analysis method
no inspectable implementation or accessible resource
unversioned demonstration repository without a stable executable and without peer-reviewed method support
duplicate wrapper around an already inventoried core engine
input or output semantics cannot support a scientifically interpretable comparison
inclusion_criteria: predicts or analyzes sequence-specific RNA-DNA-DNA triplex interactions
has an inspectable local implementation, public web resource, or archived data/code resource
has enough documentation to classify input, output, scale, and hardware semantics
was available on or before the search date

queries.result_screening_note: The broad Crossref response was relevance-screened by title and citation chaining because it contained many physical-chemistry and DNA-nanotechnology records.

semantic_compatibility_criteria.direct_runtime_candidate: Must accept frozen RNA query and DNA target sequence objects locally, emit interpretable interaction or region-level output, run without hidden precomputation, and permit a fixed resource schedule.
semantic_compatibility_criteria.landscape_only: A web resource, precomputed database, wrapper pipeline, classifier, or method with materially different alignment/output semantics may be discussed but cannot be presented as a like-for-like wall-time comparator.
semantic_compatibility_criteria.output_mapping: Native output semantics remain native; no row equivalence to LongTarget candidate sites may be claimed without a preregistered mapping. Region-level biological metrics may be used only after Phase 3 freezes the mapping.

software_availability_criteria.current_executable: Public source, identifiable version or commit, buildable local CLI, inspectable license, and a successful excluded development smoke.
software_availability_criteria.legacy_executable: Identifiable historical version and local CLI, with license/use boundary and successful excluded development smoke.
software_availability_criteria.resource: Publicly accessible web or archived resource with a stable publication or archive identifier.

sources: GitHub repository, tag, and release APIs
publisher DOI records and availability statements
existing repository related-work inventory checked on 2026-07-16
state_of_the_art_label_policy: No tool is called current state of the art solely because it was found. PATO is frozen only as the candidate current executable comparator; final wording and comparator inclusion require the Phase 3 semantic mapping.
